name: website-blocker
description: FocusFlow monorepo. The original Website Blocker extension and Expo app stay at the repo root and in mobile/.

scripts.test:focusflow: npm run test -w @focusflow/shared-types && npm run test -w @focusflow/shared-schemas && npm run test -w @focusflow/shared-utils && npm run test -w @focusflow/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @focusflow/shared-types && npm run build -w @focusflow/shared-schemas && npm run build -w @focusflow/shared-utils
scripts.typecheck:focusflow: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/shared-schemas && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/shared-utils && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/web && npm run typecheck -w @focusflow/extension
scripts.build:focusflow: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @focusflow/api && npm run build -w @focusflow/web && npm run build -w @focusflow/extension
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run start:dev -w @focusflow/api
